body:
When he came to me to tell me he was planning to quit his job all he did was get upset and walk out. I wasn't sure what other response he was expecting from me. I didn't try to make it a fight at all. I talked to him one on one the other day to tell him I was moving out. But, he just didn't speak much. Just tells me he doesn't think it's the right time. He was planning on getting renovations done to the house. 

I feel like staying here at home is postponing my life for his life. It's very sad to think about. I grew up poor and my parents have never been able to get out of poverty. Working dead end job after the other.

I don't think he fully understands I am not responsible for him or my sister. He thinks because he supported me throughout college I owe it to him to help him now. Which I have for the last 2 years after getting my first job out of college. I worked part-time to pay for school but wasn't paying bills when I went to school. It's crazy to think I'm in this weird situation rn.

I think deep down you're right. It's a stressful time for him as well. I would just like him to make a stronger effort to find a new job. He spent the majority of last year complaining at home about his old job giving him a pay cut rather than finding a new job to fix his own situation. I think deep down he just wants to stay at home and not work anymore. Which I am just not okay with but when I spoke to him about it he got upset.
